name: Code Geass: Boukoku no Akito 5 - Itoshiki Mono-tachi e
name_english: Code Geass: Akito the Exiled 5: To Beloved Ones
name_romanji: Code Geass: Akito the Exiled 5: To Beloved Ones
original_title: コードギアス　亡国のアキト 第5章 最終章「愛シキモノタチへ」
description: Fifth and final episode of Code Geass: Boukoku no Akito.  Though originally planned as a four-chapter series, it was announced by the producer Yoshitaka Kawaguchi at the premiere day event in Tokyo that the unscheduled fifth chapter titled "Itoshiki Monotachi e" (To Beloved) was already in the works as the final installment of the series for a 2015 fall release.
